description: This file defines an abstract class SMSManager responsible for managing SMS notifications related to calendar events, including sending SMS to attendees, handling rate limits, and formatting message times. It also includes helper functions for sending SMS with fallback email and retrieving organization settings.

classes.name: SMSManager
classes.description: An abstract class that manages SMS notifications for calendar events, including sending messages to attendees, checking notification settings, and formatting times.

methods.name: handleSendingSMS
methods.description: Handles the process of sending an SMS or fallback email, including rate limiting and credit checks.

methods.name: getTeamWithOrganizationSettings
methods.description: Retrieves team and organization settings from the database.

methods.name: isSMSNotificationEnabled
methods.description: Checks if SMS notifications are enabled for the event's team or globally.

methods.name: getFormattedTime
methods.description: Formats a given time into a localized string with specified format.

methods.name: getFormattedDate
methods.description: Returns a formatted date range string for the event.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Abstract method to generate the SMS message content for an attendee.

methods.name: sendSMSToAttendee
methods.description: Sends an SMS to a specific attendee if conditions are met.

methods.name: sendSMSToAttendees
methods.description: Sends SMS messages to all attendees of the event.
